front.title: The Use Case of Autonomic Traffic Management in the Artificial Intelligence Data Center

author.organization: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

abstract.t: This document describes the use case of autonomic traffic management in Artificial Intelligence Data Centers (AIDCs), including the associated management requirements and challenges. It discusses two representative approaches based on the ANIMA architecture: distributed autonomic traffic management and controller-led hybrid traffic management.
